title: How to change cursor in Linear on Mac: adjust pointer behavior for your interface
metaTitle: How to change cursor in Linear on Mac: Step-by-Step
description: Learn how to change cursor in Linear on Mac by adjusting your app preferences. Follow our guide to toggle pointer behavior for interactive elements.
intro: You can change cursor behavior in Linear on Mac by updating your interface preferences within the application settings. This allows you to toggle between a standard system arrow and a pointer icon when hovering over interactive elements.
tldr: Open the Linear desktop app on your Mac.
Press ⌘ + , to open the Preferences menu.
Go to the General tab in the settings window.
Locate the Interface and theme section.
Toggle the pointer cursor setting to match your preferred interaction style.

blocks.text: Understanding cursor behavior in the Linear app

Many users want to change cursor in Linear because they prefer a specific visual feedback when interacting with buttons or links. By default, the Linear app may use a standard arrow, but you can enable a hand pointer for better visibility. This choice often depends on whether you prefer a native macOS feel or a web-based interface experience. The setting is simple to find and does not affect your system-wide mouse settings.
Follow these steps to modify how your cursor behaves inside the desktop client. Ensure you are running the latest version of the app for the best experience.
Clarifying the difference between Linear and Cursor AI

A common point of confusion exists between the Linear project management tool and the Cursor AI code editor. If you are searching for how to change cursor in Linear because you want to integrate AI, you are likely looking for the wrong setting. The Linear app settings only control the UI pointer. To use AI features, you must look at the integration marketplace within your IDE or workspace settings.

If you need to change the size, color, or acceleration of your cursor, you must do this in the macOS System Settings. The Linear app respects your global system configuration. To change the pointer size, open System Settings, go to Accessibility, then select Display. You can adjust the pointer size slider there. For more advanced control, such as independent acceleration settings, many Mac users install third-party utilities like LinearMouse, which is unrelated to the Linear app but helps with hardware precision.

faq.question: Can I change the actual shape of the cursor icon in Linear?
faq.answer: No, you cannot change the specific icon image. You can only toggle whether the cursor changes to a hand pointer when hovering over interactive elements.

faq.question: Does changing the cursor setting in Linear affect other apps?
faq.answer: No, this setting is local to the Linear desktop application and will not change how your mouse behaves in other software.

faq.question: Why is my cursor not changing when I enable the setting?
faq.answer: Ensure you are using the official Linear desktop app and that you have saved your preferences. If the issue persists, restart the application to apply the changes.

task: Change the cursor hover behavior in the Linear desktop app
requirements: Linear desktop app installed on macOS

steps.name: Open Preferences
steps.text: Launch the Linear app and press ⌘ + , to open the settings menu.

steps.name: Navigate to General
steps.text: Click on the General tab located in the sidebar of the Preferences window.

steps.name: Adjust Pointer Setting
steps.text: Scroll down to the Interface and theme section and toggle the option for pointer cursor behavior.
steps.tip: This change takes effect immediately without needing a restart.

troubleshooting.problem: Setting does not appear in menu
troubleshooting.fix: Check for app updates or reinstall the latest version from the Linear website.
Remember that Cursor AI is a separate tool and not a setting within the Linear app.
